description: Everyone would be delighted to stand godparent to the poor man’s baby; nobody would be delighted to pay. Then a splendid lady on the forest path offers to see the child christened, if afterwards the girl will live with her. A grave, beautiful legend.
summary: A girl who lets out the star, the moon and the sun loses her voice, marries a prince, and is accused of a terrible crime when her babies vanish.
